_comment: RccGoalsFetcher (DG Sync from Rotary.org), ported from upstream 2026-11-09. Off until the 'rotary_org_dg_sync' feature is on. Secrets (DB password, RotaryOrgSync:CredentialKey, Brevo:ApiKey, Rcc:Password) go ONLY in appsettings.secrets.json next to the exe (never committed) or in environment variables such as RotaryOrgSync__CredentialKey. CredentialKey must equal the API's RotaryOrgSync:CredentialKey (base64 of 32 random bytes). See WORKER_SETUP.md.

Scope._comment: Districts fetched in batch mode: zones matched against zone_master.ZoneName, or an explicit DistrictNumbers list. Empty = none.
